title: PaymentDeclined
description: The card refused to block a sum for a load. `authorized` 0 means the load has no payment; above 0, an earlier block still stands and only a rise was refused.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

payment_id.description: The card payment of the load.

load_id.description: The load the payment is for.

load_code.description: The load's short code, for example `GW-7F3K2M`; null when billing was not told it.

booking_id.description: The haul the payment settled; null while the load has none yet.

authorized.description: What stands blocked on the card for the load after this event, whole so'm (a bare integer; `currency` is UZS today).
